conventions.surface: the water surface is the plane Y = 0 (mean sea level); depth, shoreline distance and the land mask come from the terrain pipeline's maps in scene.json terrain.water
conventions.waves: Gerstner waves: wavelength (m), amplitude (m), direction in degrees from +X toward +Z (the propagation direction), steepness 0..1; deep-water dispersion omega = sqrt(9.81 k) with k = 2 pi / wavelength. A fetch-limited wind sea for a steady 8-10 m/s westerly through the Gate (peak near 23 m / 3.8 s) plus a refracted Pacific swell pair, all travelling downwind toward -X (into the bay), spread +-30 degrees. Tiers choose how many of the longest waves displace vertices and how many shade per pixel (tiers.json).
conventions.detailLayers: tiling normal-map layers: tile size (m), rotation (degrees), RMS slope at wind 1 and drift speed downwind (m/s)
conventions.flow: ebb-tide current field (m/s, +X seaward) built from the shoreline-distance map: size is the field's texel count per side, peakSpeed the speed at the Gate constriction, gateWidth the constriction width (m); normal detail advects along it in a two-phase cycle of flowPeriod seconds
conventions.other: macroTiles are the two large-scale variation tile sizes (m); shoreBandPeriod is the time (s) between shore-foam bands; originSnap (m) is the grid to which the shading origin snaps to keep precision
